items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Four Pawn; the interviewer asks if the interviewee traveled with Four Pawn, to which the interviewee responds with a question about playing in the band, indicating no established personal connection or memory of working with them.

ctx.x: No. I don't know. You see, the boys wasn't here. We had a lot of clanded players, and the fellas around here played all of them, and they're not as good as those boys. The trumpet players were not as good as Freddie Kepp or Tommy Ladner, or Lou Armstrong or Joe Otto. We didn't have any trumpet players that good. There was a lot of them around here boys could play. They could play for music or for air, but not like Joe and those boys. And the most playing that those boys did was for air, it wasn't for music. Most…
Give me a minute. Did you travel with, was it a show, was it P.G.? Four Pawn and South Brothers Circus, and he had the band in the sideshow.
And did you play in the band?
